name: Undertow Cavern
summary: Undertow Cavern is a partially flooded cave found in Blackwood, located northwest of Leyawiin, containing goblins and minotaurs. A scholar, Amalia Vasatoln, sits outside requesting assistance in recovering the relics of a famous minotaur hunter. Undertow Torchbugs can be found inside during one of the related daily quest. A copy of Legend of Veyond is found outside the entrance in Amalia's camp. A copy of The Last Battle of Phalevon Vero is found inside the first room to the right in the cave.
notes: Undertow Cavern previously appeared in Oblivion.
